# Saved comparison

Two saved extractions and the comparison between them, with the comparator that produced it. The schema is published at its ID, `https://schemas.projections.githubnext.com/comparison-document/v0.json`; it is generated from TypeBox
definitions into [`packages/schemas/schemas/comparison-document/v0.json`](../../../packages/schemas/schemas/comparison-document/v0.json).

| Property | Type | Required | Description |

| `version` | `0` | Yes |  |
| `before` | [Saved extraction](extraction-document.md) | Yes |  |
| `after` | [Saved extraction](extraction-document.md) | Yes |  |
| `comparison` | [Comparison](comparison.md) | Yes |  |
| `comparator` | object | Yes |  |

No other properties are allowed.
